description: Every guest should be reachable on at least one channel.
Revenue cannot be attributed without a channel.
A review without a rating cannot contribute to CSAT.
Every unit-night must roll up to a property.
The same guest, unit and arrival date appearing more than once is an OTA sync double-submit, not two reservations.
Two guest records sharing a normalised phone number are the same person. Repeat-guest rate is understated until they are resolved.
One row per unit per night. A breach invalidates every rate metric.
A nightly stay must depart after it arrives.
Ratings outside 1-5 are unusable.
Negative or zero room revenue on a live booking is invalid.
A serviced-apartment stay beyond 60 nights is a data error, not a guest.
A booking cannot be made after the guest arrives.
Closing stock must equal opening + received - consumed - wastage.
Stock cannot go negative.
A gateway payment whose booking reference does not resolve. Left joined rather than dropped so the money is visible, not silently lost.
Gateway gross should equal the folio net room amount. A mismatch is either a partial payment or a reconciliation break.

A cancelled booking must carry a cancellation timestamp, and vice versa. This rule is a REGRESSION GUARD, not a detector: the mart CHECK constraint ck_booking_cancel makes the incoherent state unloadable, so the correct expected result is zero. The defect can only exist upstream of the mart, which is where the constraint earns its place -- a rule that can never fire because a constraint already prevents the state is a stronger control than a rule that reports it.
A cancelled booking must not occupy any unit-night.
The half-open interval: a unit-night on or after the departure date means room-nights are inflated by roughly 1/ALOS.
A vacant night cannot carry room revenue.
An out-of-order unit must be removed from availability.
The stored breach flag must agree with resolution time vs SLA target.
A request cannot be resolved before it was raised.
The stored reporting date must equal the IST business date derived from the event timestamp. Disagreement means a feed wrote a UTC date, which silently moves late-night activity to the previous day.
Service-request reporting date must match the IST business date.
The booking feed should have delivered data recently. Measured against the dataset's own horizon, since this is a fixed synthetic period.
A source channel that normally delivers volume and suddenly delivers nothing is a broken integration. The table is not wrong, it is EMPTY -- so a null check passes and only a volume band catches it.
Every non-cancelled booking should have a payment. A reconciliation is clean when UNEXPLAINED variance is zero, not when variance is zero.
Rooms sold can never exceed rooms available on any night.
